title: The hypertrophy series: the optimal rep range for muscle growth
summary: Hypertrophy series episode on rep ranges; the captions are unusable junk, so only the description is used. His TL;DR: all your rep ranges should sit between 2 and 12 reps, varied across exercises rather than identical.
claims: For muscle growth, all your rep ranges should fall between 2 and 12 reps; this does not mean every set is 2-12 or that all exercises use the same range
